Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one original editorial category illustration for Ben Ebsworth's Blog/Lab research folio, a separate raster artwork, not a logo or UI screenshot.

Background: true transparent alpha outside the object and in open holes. Solid opaque subject material, crisp naturally antialiased edge. No paper rectangle, background wash, ambient cloud, vignette, drop shadow, blur, glow, halo or luminous fringe.
Text: none. No letters, words, numbers, fake labels, pseudo-writing, diagrams with data, watermark or signature.
Constraints: editorial metaphor only; no real system measurements, scientific evidence or knowledge-graph data. No glossy 3D tile, glass, chrome, neon, gradient backdrop, stock icon, frame, badge, enclosing circle or contact sheet. Do not imitate a technology brand mark or imply vendor endorsement.
Subject: an original orchestrated cluster of three substantial cargo-like container modules seated at different heights in an open skeletal docking cradle. A single slim mechanical yoke aligns a fourth small module just above its matching slot; short understated routing joins the cradle. Composition feels balanced, purposeful and compact, with generous visible gaps between modules. Distinguish the modules by subtle physical edge joints, not marks. One tiny muted-red locking clip. No ship wheel, helm, heptagon emblem or Kubernetes logo; no brand blue.
